content:
The trailing-zero count is \(\min(P_2,P_5)\), where
\[
P_5=2b+g
\]
with \(b\) the exponent on \(25\) and \(g\) the exponent on \(30\).

To maximize \(P_5\), assign the two largest exponents to \(25\) and \(30\):
\[
b=11,\quad g=10 \implies P_5=2(11)+10=32.
\]
No assignment can make \(P_5>32\), so the number of zeros cannot exceed \(32\).

This is attainable: assign
\[
a=8,\ c=3,\ e=5,\ d=2,\ f=1.
\]
Then
\[
P_2=3(8)+3+2(5)+10=47,
\]
so
\[
\min(P_2,P_5)=\min(47,32)=32.
\]

\[
\boxed{32}
\]
